notes.title: What's Coming In Version 0.1.3.0?
notes.content:
[h1][b]Stability, Polishing, And Better Performance[/b][/h1]

Thanks to YoYo Games for rolling out a new version of Game Maker: Studio (Version 1.4.1567), I've had to re-write a lot of code in Project Explore to work with the many changes made since the previous build I was using.

This means I have a LOT of work to do but I want to make an important statement on this matter. Developers shouldn't bash (complain about or insult) the developers of the IDE/Software they are using to develop their games. The update was meant to bring more stability to the games produced and increase their overall performance.

Going back now and fixing all the crashes I'm getting when I run the game is actually quite an eye opening experience. There were tons of instances I was calling for that didn't exist at certain times and surely should of led to a crash but the software didn't check for this previously which led to tons of behind the scene errors. Now it checks and crashes the game returning an error message regarding the issue.

So I'd like the thank YoYo Games for enhancing the software I've been a fan of for so long.

Now that I'm done ranting... The new update for Project Explore has a lot planned for it. Here is one thing that I've already done...
[url=http://imgur.com/CLh8kUZ]Textboxes Screenshot[/url]

No more dumb popup messages when using the save system. I know it was leading to crashes and all that horrible stuff so I made sure this system is as compatible as possible.

You can now have infinitely many saved games and when clicking 'Load Game' scroll through all the files to find the one you would like to load.

I'll link the [url=https://trello.com/b/eaw5bXk9/alpha-0-1]TRELLO[/url] once more in hopes that everyone reads through the latest updates coming to version 0.1.3.0.

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: Update Version 0.1.2.9, Animal Collision Fix, New Books, And Some Small Fixes
notes.content:
I've worked at least 7 hours a day (at my day job) since 03/26/2015 and it's been rough trying to make time for Project Explore's development in between those shifts. However I feel like I owe everyone at least a minor update so here it is!

[h1][b]Changes In Version 0.1.2.9[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Fixed reaching through walls for items. (Collision rectangle was too large)
[*]Adjusted measurements of in-game kilometers
[*]Made an attempt to stop animals walking through walls
[*]Added New Item: Lord of the Pies
[*]Added New Item: The Great Frisbee
[*]Added New Item: Of Toast and Bread
[*]Added New Item: Where The Normal Things Are
[*]Changed all spawn chances to ds_lists instead of pulling them by number with a choose() function
[*]Started implementing some basic changes required for the multiplayer
[*]Integrated Steam ID for multiplayer use
[*]Fixed possible bug leading to chunk generation breaking
[*]Fixed sanity reduction GUI displaying as "0.00%" Now displays as "00%"
[/list]

[h1][b]Multiplayer Development[/b][/h1]
I've really started to buckle down and get some work done for the multiplayer. If you follow the [url=https://trello.com/b/eaw5bXk9/alpha-0-1]Project Explore Trello[/url] then you know that I've been working on it for the past few days. Well I would like to show some proof of my effort so that you know I'm not just pushing it off pretending like the works getting done.
[url=http://imgur.com/eDKZoZC]Screenshot1[/url]

I've setup a simple command system as well. It allows commands such as "edit_ip" "ip_address_here", or "edit_port" "25565". 

Well I hope you enjoyed reading this post! Thanks for playing everyone!

notes.title: Update Version 0.1.2.8 Linux Release, New Animal, and More!
notes.content:
Here it is! Finally! Sorry about the wait everyone.

[h1]Changes  In Version 0.1.2.8[/h1]
[list][*]Added New Animal: Buck
[*]Implemented new artwork (9mm pistol and Stone Pickaxe)
[*]Changed resource collecting, pick axe gets stone and rock. Axes get wood
[*]Added New Item: Stone Pickaxe
[*]Added mouse navigation to pause menu
[*]Added fullscreen option
[*]Added resolution option
[*]Fixed vsync not working all the time
[*]Implemented death animation for bear
[*]Added New Item: Metal Pickaxe
[*]Made Metal Pickaxe craftable
[*]Re-worked the splash sprite for rain drops
[*]Fixed bug when shooting animals (variable error)
[*]Arrows/Bullets will now travel past dead animals
[*]Made items on the ground non-accessible if inside a building while the player is still outside
[*]Changed the way the game checks if the player is indoors, should increase performance a bit
[*]Added new stat: Bucks Killed
[*]Fixed a few bugs in the linux version regarding collisions with bullets/arrows
[/list]
I'm really happy to announce that the Linux version is out and stable. I'm even happier to announce that we've added a new animal. For far too long we've had to sit and beat angry bears and wolves to death. We needed a new animal so badly.

Our artist (idiotekque) has been working really hard on pushing out more animals and items for the game. Every new animal in the game is his own artwork. So give him time as he does have to shade, animate, and spackle to make them look that good.

Well thanks for reading!

notes.title: Update Version 0.1.2.6 Weather, Save Fix, New Sounds!
notes.content:
[b]SAVES BETWEEN PREVIOUS VERSIONS AND THIS VERSION WILL NOT LOAD WITHOUT UNPLAYABLE BUGS![/b]

[h1]Changes in Version 0.1.2.6[/h1]
[list][*]Implemented rain effect for dynamic weather
[*]World temperature lowers when it's raining
[*]Vignette shading now adjusts depending on the weather
[*]Weather now saves to the world file
[*]Changed object index data structure to save the object name (string) instead of index. This will fix save issues between versions hopefully from this version to the next
[*]Fixed vignette shading being off sync with day & night shader for the first hour of the day & night cycle
[*]Changed arrow sprite on compass GUI
[*]Added new sound for hitting rocks/metal
[*]Modified the way scripts handled sounds, now it is more interchangeable[/list]

This update is finally fixing the save issue that has plagued each update. It was due to a change of index when I added new objects. It has been replaced with a string instead which allows me to add new objects without breaking each saved game.

I'm also going to start working on the server side stuff now so multiplayer is going to start making its way into the game hopefully in a month or two.

The new artwork will hopefully start to show a bit more in the next update. Thanks for reading!

notes.title: Update Version 0.1.2.4 New Items, Balancing, And Some Small Features!
notes.content:
I think this update is a bit of a jump from the last version. It adds a few things that the community has really been asking for and also addressing the balance issues mentioned in so many youtube videos. Unfortunately, the saves broke again between the last version and this one!

[b][h1]Changes in Version 0.1.2.4[/h1][/b]
[list][*]Fixed font size changing in perk slots when clicking on empty tabs
[*]Made doorways open to AI for navigation (Not working yet, set up for new pathing system)
[*]Fixed arrows and bullets hitting sanity creatures
[*]Increased sanity regeneration during the day time
[*]Implemented Steam screenshots (F12)
[*]Added New Item: Metal Axe
[*]Made Metal Axe craftable
[*]When damaging a structure with a weapon, the "-Number HP" displays above the object you hit
[*]Fixed foot sprite speed when using any controls besides 'SHIFT'
[*]Added New Item: Carrying Lantern
[*]Added New Item: How To Train A Bear
[*]Added "How To Train A Bear" to world generation
[*]Added Carrying Lantern to world generation
[*]Made Carrying Lantern craftable
[*]Adjusted the rate at which hunger decreases
[*]Health now regenerates when you are at least 50% hunger
[*]Added more biomes for animals to spawn into
[*]Lowered spawn rate of animals per chunk
[*]Lowered random rock drop rate and removed/added the drop to/from various biomes
[*]Implemented max crafting option by holding 'SHIFT' when clicking a crafting button
[/list]

If you have not already seen it, I have a webpage that is updated in real time as I make changes to the game and decide to add new features. The link is [url=https://trello.com/b/eaw5bXk9/alpha-0-1]https://trello.com/b/eaw5bXk9/alpha-0-1[/url]

notes.title: Update Version 0.1.2.2, Passive Perks and Construction Object With Health
notes.content:
This update WILL unfortunately break the previous version's saved game. I tried what I could to avoid this but it happened. Sorry. The good news is that now it should be mostly future proof meaning most saves will work from now on between all versions. Time for the change log!

- Fixed achievements showing incorrect values (Already Updated)
- Fixed "Robert Mitchel" to "Robert Mitchell" in the credits
- Added health to all construction objects
- Made construction objects destructible via melee weapons
- Fixed issues in the future regarding sprite index's being offset
- Rocks are broken if you have a previous saved game, sorry everybody! :P You will get an error!
- Display perks such as nearby light
- Adjusted sanity levels of the big campfire, now gives 40% reduction
- The book, "Lord of The Jewelry" has been added to the item spawn list

This isn't a massive update but I think it adds a lot of small changes that improve the experience.
